rawHelpStatements: Bet Size x Bet Level x Symbol Payout Values
● At every spin, any combinations of 4 or more symbols touching horizontally or vertically will result in a winning combination.
● For every winning combination, payout is made for each symbol according to the Paytable.
● After the payout of every round is made, all winning symbols will explode, allowing the symbols above them to cascade down for a new round.
● Additional winning combination will be tallied in every round until no more winning combination can be tallied.
● Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols.
● During any spins, winning symbols that explode will be accumulated in the collection bar above the reels.
● After a certain amount of winning symbols are collected, a feature will be triggered during the round with no winning combination.
● During any spin, if 10 or more winning symbols are collected, the Grass Dragon Feature is triggered during the round with no winning combination.
● During the Grass Dragon Feature, all low paying symbols will be removed from the reels.
● During any spin, if 30 or more winning symbols are collected, the Water Dragon Feature is triggered during the round with no winning combination.
● During the Water Dragon Feature, 4 Wild symbols will be added to the reels.
● During any spin, if 50 or more winning symbols are collected, the Fire Dragon Feature is triggered during the round with no winning combination.
● During the Fire Dragon Feature, a randomly chosen symbol (excluding Wild symbol) will be added on the reels in a checkered pattern (it will not replace any Wild symbol).
● During any spin, if 70 winning symbols are collected, the Dragon Lord Feature is triggered during the round with no winning combination.
● During the Dragon Lord Feature, all low paying symbols will be transformed into high paying symbols or a Wild symbols.

● The game will automatically return to its initial state after being idle for 30 days.Progress and status of any collection games,unfinished free games,and unfinished feature games etc will no longer be retained.
